data.title: Confronting abuse
data.description: <p>Democracy activists are often seen as a progressive group that understands equality and human rights. However, over the past few weeks, a female activist using the pseudonym "A" revealed through the online media outlet SocialGaze that she has been sexually abused by a male activist since 2024.</p>

data.title: Oil leak at data centre sparks concerns
data.description: <p>Pollution officials are inspecting a Bangkok data centre after oil-contaminated waste entered drainage pipes, raising concerns that it could reach Rama IX Canal and affect nearby communities.</p>

data.title: Govt set to  appoint new  spokesman
data.description: <p>The government is preparing to reshuffle its communications team, with Ekkapob Pianpises, known as "Dr Ek", tipped to replace Rachada Dhnadirek as government spokesman, according to a source.</p>

data.title: iLaw chief urges public to join rally
data.description: <p>Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) director Yingcheep Atchanont has called on the public to join a final rally on Sept 13, a day before the Election Commission (EC) is due to decide whether to prosecute suspects accused of colluding in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Amazon cargo plane overshoots Miami runway, hits vehicles, catches fire
data.description: MIAMI - An Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway as it landed Sunday in Miami, crashing into vehicles and catching fire, officials said.

data.title: German AfD supporters jubilant at far right's thumping win
data.description: MAGDEBURG (GERMANY) - Letting out cries of joy and jumping into the air, supporters of Germany's far-right AfD celebrated as they realised the scale of their election triumph in an ex-communist eastern state on Sunday.

data.title: Buriram, Jackson part ways
data.description: <p>Thai League 1 coaches are usually given time to fail before the axe falls -- sackings and resignations tend to pile up as a season wears on. This time, the upheaval has arrived before a ball has even been kicked.</p>

data.title: Hail the Hiro: Thai teenager bags historic ISU medal
data.description: <p>Hiro Kaewtathip made history by becoming the first Thai figure skater to win a medal at an ISU Grand Prix event.</p>

data.title: No rest for Kingdom's riders as bigger Asian Games test looms
data.description: <p>Thai sprinters raced out of their skins to spring a surprise at the Track Asia Cup 2026, lifting the Kingdom to fourth spot in the continental rankings -- but there was little time to savour the achievement, with the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya bearing down fast.</p>

data.title: Arsenal deliver statement fightback to end Chelsea's flying start
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal delivered an emphatic response to Chelsea's emergence as potential Premier League title contenders with a 2-1 win that ended their rivals' unbeaten start on Sunday.

data.title: 'Nothing has changed': FIFA confirms Infantino to run for re-election
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Gianni Infantino will stand in next March's FIFA presidential election, despite the backlash over his now-abandoned plan to bring private investment into the World Cup, football's global governing body announced Sunday.

data.title: With joy and grief, Palestinian football marks return
data.description: AL-RAM (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Palestinian sports commentator Khalil Jadallah has spent the past three years mourning the athletes killed in the Gaza war. As Palestinian football officially resumed this week, his return to the stadium proved bittersweet.

data.title: 'Truly scared': Blazes outpace firefighters in Indonesian Borneo
data.description: PONTIANAK (INDONESIA) - Toiling around the clock, haggard Indonesian firefighters on Borneo island cannot keep up with the blazes devouring landscapes and shrouding communities in a cloying haze.

data.title: Iran threatens greater force if US launches more attacks
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's top negotiator on Sunday threatened a more forceful response to any further US attacks after Tehran targeted American warships in their latest round of clashes.

data.title: Foreign interloper gropes woman at cannabis shop
data.description: CHON BURI - Police are hunting a "dark-skinned foreign man" alleged to have sexually molested one woman and kissed another at a cannabis shop in Bang Lamung district in the early hours of Sunday.

data.title: Three students lose millions to fake police, scholarship scam
data.description: Three students lost more than 2.7 million baht to call-centre scams in which the fraudsters posed as police officers and as a university lecturer offering a fake overseas scholarship.

data.title: LISA’s SaWaDiKa tops 70 million YouTube views in 24 hours
data.description: LISA credits collaborators in Thailand, Korea and Los Angeles, with tuk-tuks, Muay Thai shorts and wai-inspired choreography featuring in SaWaDiKa.

data.title: Accused teen-porn producer made B120,000 a month on OnlyFans
data.description: Police arrested a 32-year-old man accused of luring teenage girls into making pornographic videos, selling the material online and profiting to the tune of 120,000 baht a month.

data.title: Nepali rescuers buoyed by miracle finds but tough conditions persist
data.description: KATHMANDU - Nepali rescuers faced challenging conditions on Sunday as search operations after catastrophic floods entered their 12th day, buoyed by the extraordinary rescues of four survivors.

data.title: Indonesia's main airport suspends flights as Krakatoa erupts
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia halted operations at its main international airport outside Jakarta on Sunday after ash spewed from the Anak Krakatoa volcano more than 150 kilometres away, impacting thousands of passengers.

data.title: Tourists cheat death on winding downhill road
data.description: PHETCHABUN - Four tourists were lucky to survive a downhill car crash on Phu Thap Boek mountain in Lom Kao district on Sunday, saved by a concrete guardrail from plummeting into the valley below

data.title: Ancient rock paintings discovered in Nong Bua Lamphu cave
data.description: NONG BUA LAMPHU - Fine Arts officials have inspected newly found rock paintings believed to be around 4,000 years old in a cave behind a forest monastery in Na Wang district of this northeastern province, in what archaeologists say could be an important addition to Thailand's prehistoric heritage.

data.title: US aircraft carrier departs Thailand after port call
data.description: LAEM CHABANG (THAILAND) - Thousands of US sailors aboard an aircraft carrier departed from Thailand on Sunday, AFP journalists said, concluding its first port call following reports of deteriorating living conditions on board after nine months at sea.

data.title: Zheng stuns Keys as US Open upsets dim American hopes
data.description: NEW YORK - Zheng Qinwen won the last seven games to stun Madison Keys and reach the US Open last 16 on a Saturday of upsets that dented American hopes at Flushing Meadows.

data.title: China's memories of Mao fade to nostalgia 50 years after his death
data.description: NANJIE (CHINA) - The crimson flags on Nanjie village's "East is Red" Square hang limp in the sweltering summer heat as a trickle of tourists take photos with a towering statue of Chairman Mao Zedong, still gleaming white almost 50 years after he died.

data.title: Opal ends Miss World reign in SIRIVANNAVARI silk gown
data.description: Opal Suchata gave her farewell speech and crowned her successor at the 73rd Miss World Grand Final in Nha Trang, Vietnam, on September 5, 2026.

data.title: Heavy rain in Northeast, later in Greater Bangkok and other regions
data.description: Heavy rain is forecast in the Northeast early this week and then in Greater Bangkok and other regions until Friday.

data.title: British-Nigerian influencer died after penile filler procedure in Thailand
data.description: A Nigerian associate of Afrobeats star Davido has died after suffering a fatal medical complication following a cosmetic penile enlargement procedure in Bangkok.

data.title: Thai khon production based on the Ramayana story of Sita returns in 2026
data.description: The 2026 SUPPORT Foundation production follows Sida from birth to her fire ordeal and the story of her two sons. It runs from Thursday (November 5, 2026) to Thursday (December 10, 2026).

data.title: US envoys discuss 'substantive' plan with Putin towards ending Ukraine war
data.description: KYIV - American envoys discussed "substantive plan" for next steps to end the Ukraine war during their meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin, the White House said, before they headed to Kyiv on Sunday.

data.title: Thailand urged to turn herbs into high-value health products
data.description: Thailand’s trade policy office proposes four priorities, including clinical testing of herbal extracts, to move agriculture beyond price competition.

data.title: B6m car plunges into canal
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - A Porsche Cayenne worth about 6 million baht plunged into a canal in Bang Phli district, after the owner reportedly forgot to engage the parking brake.

data.title: 'The flood is coming': How a Nepal principal saved 900 students
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Rajendra Dawadi was inside his school near Nepal's Trishuli River with around 900 students last week when a colleague delivered an urgent warning.
